FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A23
Dry open roads need three counted seconds astern, while slick roads, trailers, dim sight, bikes, blind rigs and rail halts all stretch the gap to four. [A23]
Why it matters: group_hint follow-rules; prereq_hint sec05-F13; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec05-F13, sec05-F14.
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]
FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A22
Joining traffic wants a four second hole shared two seconds each way, which is roomier than the three second trail kept once settled in line. [A22]
Why it matters: group_hint merge-vs-follow; prereq_hint sec05-F09; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F09, sec05-F13.
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]
FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A25
A highway pass consumes ten seconds and sixteen hundred feet of clear road, then ends only when both victim headlights swim in the mirror. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint pass-math; prereq_hint sec05-F21; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec05-F21, sec05-F22.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]
FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A26
Right turns hug tight with no left swing feints, while left turns arc wider to gift opposing lefts their own room. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint turn-arcs; prereq_hint sec05-F26; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F25, sec05-F26.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]
FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A24
Tailgaters earn a rightward cede or a gentle slow coaxing them past, and brake checking them back only courts a rear ender. [A24]
Why it matters: group_hint tailgater; prereq_hint sec05-F15; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F14, sec05-F15.
Source: [A24 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0024]
FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A23
Green lights still forbid entering blocked crossings under ticket threat, and halfway pauses survive solely inside vehicle fitting medians. [A23]
Why it matters: group_hint cross-blocks; prereq_hint sec05-F12; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F12.
Source: [A23 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]
FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A22
Trucks can halt harder than cars despite their bulk, and their tails cheat inward on rights, so gaps grow and right side passes die. [A22]
Why it matters: group_hint truck-surprises; prereq_hint sec05-F03; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F02, sec05-F03, sec05-F04.
Source: [A22 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]
FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A25
Left lanes exist for overtaking, and roads under three lanes legally pin cruisers right except for passes, left turns and left exits. [A25]
Why it matters: group_hint lane-law; prereq_hint sec05-F24; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F20, sec05-F24.
Source: [A25 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0025]
FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A26
Reversing bans all travel lanes outright, with parallel parking and K turns the lone legal exceptions, so missed exits mean looping forward. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint reverse-ban; prereq_hint sec05-F27; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec05-F27.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]
FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A26
Blind hills and bends demand a third mile of sight and ban passes within a third mile, treating hidden crests as phantom oncoming cars. [A26]
Why it matters: group_hint hill-sight; prereq_hint sec05-F28; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec05-F21, sec05-F28.
Source: [A26 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0026]
